name: aos-phpunit
description: Parse PHPUnit tests in PHP files and run them from VS Code.

phpunitRunner.phpExecutable.description: PHP executable used when launching PHPUnit.

phpunitRunner.phpunitCommand.description: Runner command or script path, optionally followed by arguments (for example, 'artisan test'). Quote arguments containing spaces. Leave empty to auto-detect Pest or PHPUnit.

phpunitRunner.configurationFile.description: Optional phpunit.xml or phpunit.xml.dist path relative to the workspace folder or absolute on disk.

phpunitRunner.workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory relative to the workspace folder or absolute on disk. Defaults to the current file's workspace folder.

phpunitRunner.docker.enable.description: Execute PHPUnit inside a Docker container using docker exec.

phpunitRunner.docker.command.description: Docker CLI command used to execute PHPUnit inside a container, such as 'docker' or 'docker compose'.

phpunitRunner.docker.container.description: Target Docker container name or ID used when docker execution is enabled.

phpunitRunner.docker.workspacePath.description: Workspace root path inside the Docker container. Leave empty to reuse the host workspace path.

phpunitRunner.docker.execArgs.description: Additional arguments appended to docker exec before the container name.

phpunitRunner.additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments appended to every PHPUnit invocation.

phpunitRunner.parallel.processes.description: Worker processes used by the opt-in Parallel Tests profile.

phpunitRunner.command.description: Optional remote command template. Variables: ${php}, ${phpargs}, ${phpunit}, ${phpunitargs}, ${phpunitxml}, ${cwd}, ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolderBasename}, ${userHome}, ${pathSeparator}. When set, this takes precedence over docker.enable wrapping.

phpunitRunner.remote.reportTransferComma.description: Optional host command run after a custom remote or Docker test command to retrieve reports. Variables: ${workspaceFolder}, ${remoteJunitReport}, ${localJunitReport}, ${remoteCoverageReport}, ${localCoverageReport}. JUnit paths are required; coverage paths are empty outside coverage runs.

phpunitRunner.paths.description: Host-to-remote path mappings used with phpunitRunner.command (for example {"${workspaceFolder}": "/var/www/html"}).

phpunitRunner.environment.description: Extra environment variables set when launching PHPUnit.

phpunitRunner.phpArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the PHP binary (the ${phpargs} template variable).

phpunitRunner.saveBeforeTest.description: Save all dirty editors before running tests.

phpunitRunner.clearOutputOnRun.description: Clear the PHPUnit Runner output channel once when a test run starts.

phpunitRunner.insights.limit.description: Maximum slow, flaky, and latest-problem test insights shown per workspace.

phpunitRunner.output.preset.description: Format structured test results in the Test Results output.

phpunitRunner.output.sourceSnippetContex.description: Number of context lines to show around a failure source line.

colors.description: Use ANSI colors in result markers and source snippets.

icons.description: Override status markers in the progress preset and {icon} template variable.

testCase.description: Template for each result line. Variables: {status}, {icon}, {class}, {name}, {duration}, {file}, {line}, {message}.

failureLocation.description: Template for a failure location. Variables: {file}, {line}. Use an empty string to hide it.

failureMessage.description: Template for the failure message. Variable: {message}. Use an empty string to hide it.

sourceSnippet.description: Show the nearby PHP source frame for readable local failures.

phpunitRunner.output.format.description: Override details in the selected output preset.

phpunitRunner.continuousTesting.description: Automatically rerun tests in a PHP file whenever it is saved.

phpunitRunner.excludeGlobs.description: Glob patterns excluded when discovering PHPUnit tests.

phpunitRunner.testFileGlobs.description: Glob patterns used when refreshing PHPUnit tests across the workspace. Ignored when phpunit.xml defines testsuites.

phpunitRunner.debuggerConfig.description: launch.json configuration name used when debugging tests. Leave empty to start a generic PHP Xdebug listener.

phpunitRunner.xdebugPort.description: Xdebug client port used when phpunitRunner.debuggerConfig is empty. Set to 0 to choose an available port automatically.
